assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: 方案仅对已提供的临时边界与提交设计图层作 formal 评审；法定控制仍待专业确认。

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key areas use provisional polygons from provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.impact: 临时边界只用于生成、自检与讨论；official polygon 发布后 site/key/land_use/roads/green/public/buildings/phasing/metrics 均需重算。
